title: Globestudio look preset
description: Shape of a single entry in `src/data/look-presets.js`. Community preset submissions should validate against this schema. The `settings` payload follows the main configuration schema (https://globestudio.app/schema/config.json) minus the `version` envelope.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Used in `/looks/:id` URLs, `?look=:id` embed params, and the `preset` enum in config.json. Once shipped, an id must not change — it's a public URL.

name.description: Display name shown in the preset switcher. Title Case, short enough to fit in a 160px chip.

blurb.description: One-line tagline shown under the name. No trailing period.

previewImage.description: Optional path (absolute or root-relative) to a static preview image used in social cards and OG previews. PNG, ~1200x630.

settings.description: The Globestudio configuration that produces this look. Any field accepted by the config schema is allowed here, with one difference: `version` is not required (presets are not versioned files — the bundling app owns the version envelope).
